name: yatra-iq
description: Yatra IQ - Know the crowd before you board

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend,simulator" -c "cyan,green,yellow" "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=simulator"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=frontend && npm run lint --workspace=backend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
